cands.bio: Republican nominee for Alabama House District 8. Morgan County native and University of North Alabama graduate. Has owned a Decatur insurance agency for over 17 years. Former chairman of the Decatur-Morgan Chamber of Commerce and past president of the Decatur Kiwanis Club.

endorsements.text: His campaign site says he is endorsed by Rep. Terri Collins and the Alabama Farmers Federation. This is his own claim; Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him.

cands.gaps: We found no specific stated positions on any policy issue. His campaign site gives only general themes (conservative values, servant leadership), and its issues page was not available to us. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey. We found no record of earlier elected office, no bills or official actions by him, no documented land-use or data-center stances, no controversies, and no foreign ties. His birthplace and upbringing in Morgan County come only from his campaign site's description of him as a lifelong native raised on a family farm. We found no independent source confirming them.

cands.bio: Janine Jordan was the Democratic nominee for Alabama House District 8 in 2026. The party chose her as the replacement nominee after Bruce Sparkman withdrew. She lost the general election to Republican Patrick Johnson. No other career or office history was found.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as endorsed by the voter guide "Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy" (Sway voting group by Tevin (Momala) Davis).

cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Janine Jordan was born or raised, when she moved to Alabama, or her career and any previous offices. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, so we have no stated positions on data centers, property taxes, growth and land, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or education. We found no public statements or actions on these topics, and no reported controversies or foreign ties.

score.why: Raised $775, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: No occupation, prior elected office or policy background was found in the available sources.
